cL.text: You will need to download an FNF mod (on Gamebanana or Gamejolt) to get its JSON. It's usually found in the data folder (which is inside the mods folder, or assets folder for older mods)

f_.text: Keys are referring to how many arrows there are on one side of the screen, not the total amount of arrows combined.
